use_cases: Display multiple pricing plans in a bento-grid layout for easy comparison
Toggle between monthly and yearly billing cycles with dynamic price updates
Show feature comparison across different pricing tiers with checkmark icons
Highlight popular or recommended plans with custom badges
Redirect users to checkout flow based on selected plan
ai_summary: A bento-grid styled pricing component that displays multiple subscription plans in a visually organized grid layout. Features a monthly/yearly billing toggle switch with dynamic price calculations and feature lists with checkmark/X icons for comparison. Includes support for popular plan badges, customizable grid classes for different card widths, and a clean card-based UI structure.
